name: Google Tasks
label: Google Tasks API v1
description: Google Tasks API v1 via OfficialApiNode (nodes/google-tasks/api_spec.json). Official Tasks API v1. No first-party webhooks; listen is ingress-only (BPMN message event). Official docs: https://developers.google.com/workspace/tasks/reference/rest. OUTPUT is {status, http_status, data} or {error}. Secrets never appear on OUTPUT.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: One Google Tasks official API call. Delivered as inputVariables.input. Set operation plus the path/query/body fields that operation lists in api_spec.json. Do not put secrets on this port. Example: {"operation":"add_task"}.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Which official HTTP verb to run. Overrides instance operation when non-blank. EXACT accepted values: 'add_task', 'get_task', 'list_tasks', 'update_task', 'delete_task', 'list_tasklists', 'create_tasklist'. listen/trigger/webhook_listen never open a socket — they return an error telling you to use a BPMN message event. Example: 'add_task'.

schema.label: tasklist
schema.description: Request field for operations that declare `tasklist` as a path, query, or JSON body key. Omitted/blank is dropped. Example: 'example-value'.

schema.label: title
schema.description: Request field for operations that declare `title` as a path, query, or JSON body key. Omitted/blank is dropped. Example: 'example-value'.

schema.label: notes
schema.description: Request field for operations that declare `notes` as a path, query, or JSON body key. Omitted/blank is dropped. Example: 'example-value'.

schema.label: due
schema.description: Request field for operations that declare `due` as a path, query, or JSON body key. Omitted/blank is dropped. Example: 'example-value'.

schema.label: status
schema.description: Request field for operations that declare `status` as a path, query, or JSON body key. Omitted/blank is dropped. Example: 'example-value'.

schema.label: task
schema.description: Request field for operations that declare `task` as a path, query, or JSON body key. Omitted/blank is dropped. Example: 'example-value'.

schema.label: maxResults
schema.description: Request field for operations that declare `maxResults` as a path, query, or JSON body key. Omitted/blank is dropped. Example: 'example-value'.

schema.label: pageToken
schema.description: Request field for operations that declare `pageToken` as a path, query, or JSON body key. Omitted/blank is dropped. Example: 'example-value'.

schema.label: showCompleted
schema.description: Request field for operations that declare `showCompleted` as a path, query, or JSON body key. Omitted/blank is dropped. Example: 'example-value'.

schema.label: Parent task
schema.description: Task parent id. add_task body + query. Creates a subtask. Example: Tk1.

schema.label: Previous sibling
schema.description: add_task query previous — place this task after that sibling id.

schema.label: Completed at
schema.description: Task.completed RFC3339. add_task / update_task. Set status=completed as well.

schema.label: Deleted
schema.description: Task.deleted. add_task / update_task.

schema.label: Show deleted
schema.description: list_tasks showDeleted.

schema.label: Show hidden
schema.description: list_tasks showHidden.

schema.label: Due min
schema.description: list_tasks dueMin RFC3339.

schema.label: Due max
schema.description: list_tasks dueMax RFC3339.

schema.label: Completed min
schema.description: list_tasks completedMin RFC3339.

schema.label: Completed max
schema.description: list_tasks completedMax RFC3339.

schema.label: Updated min
schema.description: list_tasks updatedMin RFC3339.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Handler result object. Success: status='ok', http_status, data (parsed JSON). Example: {"status":"ok","http_status":200,"data":{}}. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: Status
schema.description: Present on HTTP 2xx. EXACT value: 'ok'. Example: 'ok'.

schema.label: HTTP status
schema.description: Provider HTTP status code. Example: 200.

schema.label: Data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body from the official API, or the raw string when not JSON. Example: {}.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Default official API call for this instance when input.operation is blank. EXACT accepted values: add_task, get_task, list_tasks, update_task, delete_task, list_tasklists, create_tasklist. Default: add_task. Example: add_task.

configurationParameters.label: Access Token
configurationParameters.description: Provider credential for auth.type=bearer (configKey access_token). REQUIRED secret — StudioQuack secret binding only; never put this on INPUT. Never logged. Example: 'redacted-token'.

configurationParameters.label: Default task list
configurationParameters.description: Default tasklist id when INPUT is empty. @default is the account's primary list.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout (seconds)
configurationParameters.description: Connect+read timeout for the official HTTPS call. Positive integer. Blank/0/negative → 25. Example: 25.
